reviews.title: Only the app works..ish
reviews.text:
I purchased for $30 a year because it claimed that I could use the keyboard in other apps and translate (without having to use AI in another search engine or app and then paste). 
I downloaded the keyboard onto my phone, it shows, I select it ( it changed my keyboard so everything is a bit off but I’ll get over that) BUT it’s like it freezes when I try to select it. They keyboard function hasn’t word once. Customer service or tutorials don’t show how to troubleshoot, only how to download AND it makes you for it access to everything you type including passwords. I understand this if I’m actually able to use it within an app- but since it doesn’t work how described it feels really phishy. 
 SAVE YOUR MONEY AND DONT PURCHASE. It’s the same as free iTranslate or just google search for translating 😅

reviews.title: Best translation software I've found
reviews.text: I bought this as an aid for a trip to Paris, since I know maybe ten words of French. It was a great help, quickly and accurately translating 99% of the words I typed in (the other 1% it just didn't know or turned out to be somebody's name). It also translated phrases, which was even more helpful. And it is so instinctive and user-friendly. Now that I'm back in the States, I use it when I encounter a German word I don't know (I am taking lessons to improve my skills). And I could use it for many, many other languages, too: Hungarian, Finnish, Spanish, you name it. It goes from English to another language as easily as it goes from another language to English. I have tried four or five other online translators, and this is the one to buy.
